dedupe_keys.name: road traffic counts on departmental roads hauts de seine france

description: This dataset of the Hauts-de-Seine department gives road traffic counts on departmental roads, taken with permanent electromagnetic loops in the pavement or temporary pneumatic-tube counters. It reports annual average daily traffic (TMJA) and average working-day traffic (TMJO), and notes that the counting frequency differs by road, with the largest axes counted all year. The catalogue API reported 368 records and a last modification on 1 August 2025. Coverage: departmental roads of Hauts-de-Seine, west of Paris. Format and access: open download and API. Licence and cost: Licence Ouverte (Etalab), free. Caveats: mixed permanent and temporary counts, so years and precision differ by site. It supports network flow and capacity planning studies of suburban roads. It relates to the Bison Futé national access point and GB road traffic counts in the catalogue.
